BiblicalUsage: Topheth is the valley of the son of Hinnom, where children were burned to Molech. Josiah defiled Topheth so no man might make his son or daughter pass through the fire, and Jeremiah says they built the high places of Tophet to burn their sons and daughters, which God commanded not, neither came it into His heart.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Topheth is the Bible's blackest ground: a place where parents burned their own children, and God says the thought never came into His heart. I believe Josiah's defiling of it is the right answer — such a place should be made unusable, not merely condemned.
